facts.raw_span: A 34-year old African American woman
history of nodular sclerosing type stage IIE Hodgkin lymphoma
treated with 4 cycles of ABVC followed by 3060 cGY at the neck and mediastinum
painless, left upper eyelid mass
previously been excised on 3 separate occasions
painless proptosis
left-sided facial numbness seventeen months later
Histopathology: Revealed a multinodular proliferation of osteoclastlike multinucleated giant cells and mononuclear cells demonstrating increased mitotic activity
Immunohistochemistry was positive for CD68 and negative for CD45, S100, desmin, and lysozyme
Axial T1-weighted fat-saturated postgadolinium MRI shows lesion with marked interval enlargement within the orbit and extension through the frontal sinus into the intracranial compartment
Axial T1-weighted postgadolinium MRI shows tumor centered at the left cavernous sinus and orbital apex involving the left intracavernous/supraclinoid segments of the internal carotid artery
Next-generation sequencing of the tumor demonstrated a splicing variant (c.2515-1G>A) in the partner and localizer of BRCA2 (PALB2)
